ui_bugs.issue: Review-request expects alliance-public-war-blocked text to be visible on the TRZ public page when a MERCENARY alliance ([MERC]) views a target it is already at WAR with. In /app/frontend/app/alliance/[id].tsx line 111 the war-blocked <T> only renders when `state === 'NEUTRAL' && !can('war_vote')`. Because state=WAR here (contract active), no war button is shown but the explanatory war-blocked text is also hidden. peace-locked correctly shows 'Pace bloccata da un contratto mercenario'. Consider rendering war-blocked whenever a MERCENARY cannot propose war (any state), or the review-request should be treated as satisfied by the absence of the war button. Reference: /app/frontend/app/alliance/[id].tsx:111-114.

rca_of_issue: F: alliance-public-war-blocked text absent on TRZ public page (rival viewer) — RCA: /app/frontend/app/alliance/[id].tsx line 111 gates the text on `state === 'NEUTRAL'`. During iteration 11 the mercenary contract was accepted, moving the relation directly to WAR, and code therefore hides both the war button AND the war-blocked explanatory text. Impact: cosmetic — user still understands mercenaries can't vote war because alliance-votes-mercenary text on Diplomazia screen explicitly says 'Le compagnie Mercenarie non votano guerre'. Recommended fix: extend condition to `(state === 'NEUTRAL' || (isMerc && state === 'WAR')) && !can('war_vote')`.
